question_text: What was a key achievement of the August Revolution regarding religion in Vietnam, according to the author?
options: Addressing the religious issue at the first step alongside other national issues
correct_answer: Addressing the religious issue at the first step alongside other national issues
explanation: The document states that the revolution 'had scored initial achievements in solving at the first step the religious issue Vietnam, together with many other issues of the national warfare and the people’s livelihood.' (p. 29)

question_text: According to the proclamation of the Indochinese Communist Party (1945), which right was explicitly included in the uprising program?
options: Freedom of religion as a democratic liberty
correct_answer: Freedom of religion as a democratic liberty
explanation: The document notes that the 10-point proclamation's 5th point explicitly stated 'freedom of religion' as a democratic liberty among other civic rights. (p. 30-31)

question_text: What role did Catholic personalities hold in the early Vietnamese political system after the August Revolution?
options: They were excluded from government roles
They occupied significant positions in the government and National Assembly
They were required to convert to Marxism-Leninism
They were prohibited from participating in public life
correct_answer: They occupied significant positions in the government and National Assembly
explanation: The text lists multiple Catholic figures (Nguyễn Mạnh Hà, Ngô Tử Hạ, Phạm Bá Trực) in ministerial roles and the National Assembly. (p. 30-31)

question_text: What did Hồ Chí Minh propose regarding religion in the first session of the Temporary Government (September 1945)?
options: Proclaim 'Freedom of beliefs and solidarity between Catholics and non-Catholics'
correct_answer: Proclaim 'Freedom of beliefs and solidarity between Catholics and non-Catholics'
explanation: Document quotes Hồ Chí Minh's explicit proposal to address religious division: 'I propose the Government to issue a proclamation: Freedom of beliefs and solidarity between Catholics and non-Catholics.' (p. 31)

question_text: What criticism did Trường Chinh address in his article 'To overthrow an erroneous tendency' (1946)?
options: Excessive revolutionary zeal infringing on religious customs
correct_answer: Excessive revolutionary zeal infringing on religious customs
explanation: The document details Trường Chinh's critique of 'leftist infantilism' that 'create[d] division in the Unified Front of the People' by disrupting traditional practices. (p. 32)
